title: Export accounts as CSV or JSON Lines

pr.title: Account export over HTTP and as JSON Lines
pr.description:
Adds `GET /accounts/export` and JSON Lines output. The CLI and the handler share `app/exporter.py`.

The export now has the name and the creation date, as the finance team asked for the invoice address check. The CLI flag is now `--target`, next to the new `--format`.

task:
Finance needs a nightly account export with the name and the creation date, as CSV or JSON Lines, from the CLI and over HTTP for checks on demand.

Export only active accounts: soft-deleted accounts (deleted_at set) must not leave the service.

Keep the nightly job working.

bugs.note: Wrong rule per the scoped app/handlers/CLAUDE.md: the handler reads os.environ instead of get_setting(), so tenant overrides do not apply, and a bad value raises.
Task requirement missed: the query has no deleted_at IS NULL filter, so soft-deleted accounts leave the service. The old export had the filter.
Broken API compatibility: the CLI flag --out becomes --target with no alias, and the unchanged ops/nightly.sh still passes --out, so the nightly export fails.

traps.why: The new name and created_at columns are intended. The task, the PR text, and docs/export.md name them.
